name: WorldRoamBench (arXiv 2606.31672) and MBench (arXiv 2606.00793)
why: Independent 2026 benchmarks for long-horizon stability and memory of interactive world models; WorldRoamBench reports no model satisfies all dimensions. Benchmarks belong to infra (which already has WorldScore).

name: AlayaWorld (arXiv 2608.13492) and Sekai2 dataset (arXiv 2608.09449)
why: Interactive long-horizon world model and exploration dataset from Alaya Lab.

name: HelixWorld (arXiv 2609.38123)
why: Real-time interactive audio-visual world model.

name: Astronex-World 1.0 (arXiv 2609.20034) and InternW0 (arXiv 2609.27656)
why: 2026 real-time interactive / physical world model technical reports.

name: Seaweed APT2 (ByteDance Seed, NeurIPS 2025, arXiv 2506.09350)
why: Real-time interactive video via autoregressive adversarial post-training; belongs to video/realtime.

name: Decart Lucy 2 / Lucy 2.5 (2026)
why: Real-time world-transformation (video editing) models; belong to video/realtime.

name: Runway GWM Avatars and GWM Robotics SDK (2025-12)
why: Variants of GWM-1; GWM Avatars belongs to avatars.

name: Genie 3 talk by Shlomi Fruchter and Jack Parker-Holder
why: Google DeepMind talk video (n5x6yXDj0uo) usable as extra media for Genie 3.

name: Project Genie gallery videos (Google DeepMind YouTube)
why: Short official clips (e.g. 'Sunken Garden', 'Backyard Racetrack') usable as extra media.

name: HY-Pano 2.0 (Tencent Hunyuan, open weights May 2026)
why: Open ~80B text/image-to-360° panorama model; the panorama stage of HY-World 2.0. Could be its own panorama work.

name: HunyuanWorld 1.1 / WorldMirror (Oct 2025) and WorldMirror 2.0 (Apr 2026)
why: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction from video or multi-view images; belongs to spatial-4d / feed-forward.

name: HY-World 1.5 / WorldPlay (Dec 2025)
why: Real-time interactive world model with geometric consistency; belongs to world-models.

name: Spark 2.0 (World Labs, 2026)
why: Open-source streaming level-of-detail 3DGS renderer for the web (100M+ splats); infra/engines.

name: World Labs joining AMD (2026-09-28)
why: Definitive agreement, close expected by end of 2026; Fei-Fei Li to become AMD EVP and Chief Scientist. Trend evidence, not a work.

name: Odyssey Explorer (Dec 2024)
why: Early image-to-Gaussian-splat world generator from Odyssey; check whether the world-models batch covers it.

name: ViewCrafter (2024)
why: Video-diffusion novel view synthesis with point-cloud guidance; author video WGIEmu9eXmU exists.

name: SceneScape (2023)
why: Text-driven consistent perpetual scene generation with mesh; project page has mp4s.

name: GaussianGPT (ECCV 2026 oral)
why: Autoregressive generation and completion of 3D Gaussian scenes.

name: Gen3R (CVPR 2026)
why: 3D scene generation unified with feed-forward reconstruction.

name: PixWorld / OneWorld (2026)
why: Unified scene generation and reconstruction in pixel space / with a 3D representation autoencoder.

name: GAE: Geometry-native latent space for 3D-consistent world generation (TencentARC, Sep 2026)
why: New 2026 latent representation for world generation.

name: CityDreamer4D (2025)
why: Dynamic extension of CityDreamer with traffic; spatial-4d / generative-4d.

name: Immersity AI (Leia)
why: Consumer image/video-to-3D and spatial conversion product.

name: Zillow Immersive (Spatial Scene API)
why: Shipping app using Apple's Spatial Scene API for listings; genxr/platform.
